title: Wide Undercut Rock Cliff Shelter
description: One original complete wide undercut natural cliff terrain module. A full-width grounded irregular rear cliff connects through a shallow foot terrace to a heavy projecting angular rock roof, making a broad shaded C-section recess open at the front and both lateral ends. The unequal thick roof profile and uneven broad back are one closed continuous shared-vertex rock body, not a stack of independent slabs, central-pillar caprock, two-foot through arch or low small-mouth mound. All five full new slices and their connecting faces are authored here; no previous cliff, ravine, bridge, failed caprock or burrow geometry imported or hidden. Three opaque matte mineral roles, no texture or decor. One terrain module, zero scenes; the roof, wall and terrace are not separate assets. Metres, Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Cut lateral outlines are explicit module boundaries; no compatibility with other cliff modules promised. Static stylised natural appearance only, no geology, erosion, navigability, usable shelter, stability, climbing or real-world safety claim.
